column1: # Constants NO test can pin, with the reason. The sweep (tools/kiss_constant_sweep.py)
# reports these separately and never as findings.
# ⚠️ AN UNGUARDED CONSTANT IS NOT AUTOMATICALLY A DEFECT. A value that is reserved and
# never emitted has no observable behaviour to assert, so a golden for it would pin a byte
# no conformant producer ever writes. Merging the two categories inflates the finding rate
# -- measured in the #409 Phase 0 sample, where TAG_REDUCE alone would have inflated one
# A row here is a CLAIM that requires a reason a reader can check. It is not an opt-out.

column3: KISS-OPS-6.20-0005 states this tag is "reserved -- never emitted, no consumer". Nothing emits it, so no test can observe its value; a golden would assert a byte no conformant producer writes.
